automated_integration_testing_justificat: tests/multipeer/ runs 13 integration and adversarial tests driving two real Syncthing peers across a private Docker bridge on every PR. Required CI gate: .github/workflows/ci.yml job 'multipeer-e2e'; the architecture is documented in docs/architecture.md.
regression_tests_added50_justification: Every fix in the v0.7.0 cycle shipped with a pinning test: PR #7 added TestConcurrentTrackUntrack as the state.toml race reproducer; PR #8 added TestWriteFileAtomic_* for atomic write semantics; PR #11 added TestConfigCheckCorrupt*HintsRecovery; PR #12 added TestWriteFileAtomic_TempNameMatchesSyncthingIgnore; PR #13 added the cross-compile CI gate. Test-for-every-fix is policy, not exception.
test_statement_coverage80_justification: The race-enabled CI job publishes a project-wide statement-coverage artifact on every PR. A fresh run on 2026-08-13 measured 60.0% aggregate coverage, so the 80% criterion is not yet met even though several core internal packages are above 80%.
test_policy_mandated_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md mandates: golangci-lint clean, 'go test -race' green, and (for cross-machine sync code) the multipeer-e2e job. Branch protection on main requires five status checks for ordinary PR merges: build, lint, multipeer-e2e, fuzz-smoke, Analyze (go).
static_analysis_justification: golangci-lint v2.11.4 is pinned in .github/workflows/ci.yml as a hard CI gate. CodeQL Go analysis runs via .github/workflows/codeql.yml on every PR and weekly on schedule; its 'Analyze (go)' job is a required check for ordinary merges.
dynamic_analysis_justification: Go data-race detector ('go test -race') runs against the full test suite on every PR, including the multipeer e2e suite. .github/workflows/ci.yml job 'fuzz-smoke' runs each declared Go fuzz target (3 currently) for 30s per PR.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: The Go race detector instruments memory accesses for data races; fuzz targets exercise the TOML config parser at file boundaries. These two layers cover the most common unsafe-state classes for this codebase (concurrent shared state + untrusted input parsing).
documentation_architecture_justification: docs/architecture.md is the readable narrative; 6 ADRs (docs/adr/0001-…0006-…) document the load-bearing decisions through the Syncthing v2 migration. ADR 0005 covers the atomic-write + flock locking architecture introduced in v0.7.0.
documentation_security_justification: SECURITY.md describes the vulnerability disclosure process via GitHub Security Advisories (https://github.com/julian-corbet/dotkeeper/security/advisories/new), the 48-hour acknowledgement window, and the credit policy for reporters.
documentation_quick_start_justification: README.md has install and quick-start sections covering GitHub Releases binaries, Homebrew, AUR, and source installation. Per-platform service-setup instructions are linked from the README.
documentation_current_justification: CHANGELOG.md follows Keep a Changelog v1.1.0 and lists every release through v1.2.9. ADRs through 0006 cover the current architecture, including the Syncthing v2 migration.
code_of_conduct_justification: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md is the Contributor Covenant 2.1, in force since 2026-05-13.
roles_responsibilities_justification: CODEOWNERS specifies the maintainer for every directory; SECURITY.md names the disclosure channel; CONTRIBUTING.md describes the PR-review path.
installation_common_justification: Common install paths cover the major platforms: GitHub Releases (multi-arch deb/rpm/apk/pkg.tar.zst plus tar.gz/zip archives and SHA-256 checksums); the Homebrew tap (homebrew-dotkeeper); AUR packages (dotkeeper-bin and dotkeeper-git); and go install for supported Go toolchains. GHCR is not counted because anonymous pulls were not available when checked on 2026-08-13.
vulnerability_response_process_justifica: SECURITY.md commits to acknowledgement within 48 hours via GitHub Security Advisories. Dependabot vulnerability alerts and automated security-fix PRs are enabled on the public repository.
vulnerability_report_credit_justificatio: SECURITY.md states reporters are credited in the relevant CHANGELOG entry unless they request anonymity.
crypto_used_network_justification: All cross-machine sync traffic flows through embedded Syncthing, which uses TLS for every peer-to-peer connection. dotkeeper does not implement its own network protocol.
crypto_tls12_justification: The pinned Syncthing library constructs its device-to-device TLS configuration with SecureDefaultTLS13(), whose minimum version is tls.VersionTLS13. dotkeeper inherits this and exposes no TLS-version override.
crypto_certificate_verification_justific: Embedded Syncthing uses self-signed device certificates; the device ID IS the certificate hash. Pairing requires explicit mutual device-ID exchange (dotkeeper peer add). Connections to an unrecognised peer are rejected.
dependency_monitoring_justification: Dependabot runs weekly across Go modules, GitHub Actions, and Docker base images (.github/dependabot.yml), with security updates opened as alerts arrive. govulncheck runs on every PR via .github/workflows/ci.yml as a reachability-aware CVE scan. Dependabot vulnerability alerts and auto-security-fixes are enabled on the public repository.
